headline: European Industry Groups Warn Leaders Against Proposed €40 Billion EU Budget Cuts
summary: European corporate leaders warned EU summit officials against proposed €40 billion cuts to the draft budget. Industry groups argued that spending reductions in competitiveness and defense damage long-term economic growth.
why: The EU multi-year budget funds cross-border infrastructure, technology research, industrial innovation, and regional market development.

impacts.name: European Union
impacts.why: Reductions in regional competitiveness funding could hamper European corporate innovation.
